# Observability (Prometheus + Grafana)

```bash
make serve                                   # API on :8000, exposes /metrics
make observability-up                        # Prometheus :9090 + Grafana :3000 (admin/admin), folder "MLOps"
make traffic                                 # 3 min of live traffic; drift kicks in after 90 s
```

## Dashboards (generated by `scripts/build_dashboards.py`)
| Dashboard | Answers |
|---|---|
| **MLOps · Service health** | Is the API fast and healthy? Request rate, 5xx rate, p50/p95/p99, inference time per variant, errors by stage, CPU/memory |
| **MLOps · Model quality & drift** | Is the *model* still good? Monitor verdict timeline, PSI per feature (+ prediction drift), live AUC vs training, calibration gap, predicted-vs-actual churn, probability heatmap |
| **MLOps · Rollouts & lifecycle** | What is the platform doing? Shadow / A-B mode, traffic share, champion + challenger versions, failures, cumulative automated decisions, annotations on every promotion |

## Alert rules (`prometheus/alerts.yml`)
| Alert | Severity | Fires when |
|---|---|---|
| ApiDown | critical | target unreachable 1 m |
| HighErrorRate | critical | > 5 % 5xx for 5 m |
| HighPredictionLatencyP95 | warning | p95 > 500 ms for 5 m |
| NoPredictionTraffic | warning | zero predictions for 15 m |
| ChallengerFallbacks / ShadowErrors | warning | challenger throws on live or mirrored traffic |
| ModelDriftCritical | critical | monitor verdict = critical for 5 m |
| FeatureDriftHigh | warning | any feature PSI > 0.25 for 10 m |
| CalibrationGapHigh | critical | \|predicted − actual churn\| > 10 % |
| AucDegraded | critical | live AUC > 0.07 below training |
| MonitoringStale | warning | worker hasn't run for 1 h |
| AutoRetrainBlocked | warning | retraining refused (bad data) in the last hour |
| ModelPromoted | info | an automatic promotion happened in the last 10 m |

## Design notes
* **Two kinds of metrics.** In-process counters/histograms for what this replica sees; a DB-backed collector (computed at scrape
  time) for platform state produced by *other* processes (the worker's monitoring runs, lifecycle events, rollout state).
* **Bounded cardinality.** HTTP labels use the route *template* (`/predict/batch`), never the raw URL; feature names are fixed by the data contract.
* **Robust alerting.** Lifecycle alerts use a *last-event timestamp* gauge instead of `increase()` on a counter, because `increase()` misses the first
  event of a counter that appears with a non-zero value.
* **Dashboards as code.** Edit `scripts/build_dashboards.py`, regenerate, and tests fail if JSON and generator diverge, if any query references a metric
  the API doesn't emit, or if `promtool` rejects a query.
* One uvicorn worker per container, scale with replicas: Prometheus sums counters across replicas (`sum by (...)`); the DB-derived gauges are identical on every replica (use `max`/`avg`, which the dashboards do implicitly via single-series queries).
